verdict.rationale: Baseten ships first-party client tooling. Truss is an official open-source Python package for packaging and deploying models. The Performance Client is an official library for Python, JavaScript, and Rust. Model APIs are also OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, so you can use those vendors' standard client SDKs. A community report on a GIL-releasing Rust client corroborates the high-throughput client use case. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose official SDK for the inference and management API beyond Truss and the Performance Client, an OpenAPI spec for generating SDKs (probes returned 404), and in-depth SDK reference docs with independent hands-on corroboration.
